tranches.name: Real Product Spine, Persistence & Convergence Cutover
tranches.outcome: Installed Android and Windows clients boot into the real Multiversal shell, use real persisted local identity/profile/state, load the governed Library/corpus, and no longer expose synthetic local-alpha fixtures as ordinary product data. A live-source convergence ledger classifies every user-facing implementation as integrated, stranded, internal-only, fixture/test-only, or intentionally deferred.
acceptance: Production App entry no longer defaults to LocalAlphaIdentityAdapter, synthetic fixture campaigns/characters, or diagnostic-first navigation.

packages/local-store (or an architecture-conforming replacement at the approved boundary) contains a real durable local implementation using the canonical application-data location and SQLite/local persistence rules.
Real profile/identity, selected context, app preferences, and resumable Home state survive process/device restart.

The actual packaged Library/corpus and provenance support load successfully on Android and Windows, or a concrete missing packaged dependency is repaired rather than hidden behind a generic unavailable state.
The production shell consumes current UI-convergence + UI-system/skin work and presents mobile/desktop layouts without alpha/debug labels.
A machine-readable convergence ledger covers all current live user-facing source families, including post-Bible additions; no later feature is silently dropped.

Publish the current-engine Asset Demand Ledger covering character/creature/entity, item/equipment, environment/terrain, structure/prop, map/token, effects/animation, UI/skin, audio and specialty/3D needs, with each demand classified by primary/generated/imported/fallback/unresolved strategy.
Record primary-art dependencies and variation dimensions so later tranches know what must be authored once versus generated from primaries.

tranches.name: Real Character, Campaign, World, Scene & Pixel-Asset Foundation
tranches.outcome: A single user can create/open a real campaign/world, create or select a real character, establish ownership/control, prepare a scene, close the app, reopen it, and resume that same governed state. Character visuals are produced by an onboard deterministic pixel-art generator driven by Character Designer parameters and a compact governed primary-art library rather than one-off sprites for every combination.
acceptance: Character creation/sheet/advancement use real repository/persistence boundaries, not fixture adapters.
Campaign membership, world/campaign ownership, scene preparation, first-party content selection and role-safe projections are durable.
Home resumes the active campaign/character/scene in <=2 interactions on phone and desktop.
First-party SMB-08/09 content is consumable as product data, not only golden-test input.
Implement the onboard deterministic pixel-art generator with governed primary parts, semantic palette/mask regions, layer/anchor metadata, offline generation/cache, and Character Designer binding.
Publish the first governed Primary Pixel Asset Pack sufficient for representative person-scale character creation and extension seams for creatures, items and scenes.

All PCV-02 Character/Campaign/World/Scene actions remain usable from phone in a phone-optimized layout; no capability is desktop-only, and the shell remains compatible with the shared phone Desktop View zoom/pan mode.

tranches.name: Identity, Authentication, Device & Recovery Contract Closure
tranches.objective: Close stable-subject authentication, local proof-of-possession, device/session continuity, recovery/rebind and BRP lifecycle ownership before remote membership or transport implementation.
acceptance: Define the production-local zero-service proof-of-possession credential and canonical A3 session establishment path.
Define stable device identity as connection/recovery context without making device identity equal subject identity.
Close BRP device-session revocation/recovery/data-rights composition.
Restore or explicitly retire A3 authentication-session assurance/device/last-validation metadata with evidence.
Reconcile PCV-01 local profile identity records with IdentityServicePort, ProviderIndependentIdentityMapping and StableSubjectSessionPort.
No remote caller can assert a subjectId/identityId pair without the canonical authentication boundary.

tranches.name: Invitation, Membership, Role, Policy & Atomicity Closure
tranches.objective: Close A3 invitation→A5 Campaign membership/role lifecycle, versioning, family-safety policy and atomic transaction semantics without parallel membership authority.
acceptance: A3 acceptance and A5 membership creation/replay have one atomic coordinator and one membership authority.
Campaign membership lifecycle fields, role vocabulary, version/concurrency token and state transitions are complete and obtainable through public contracts.
MIB-17/SMB-14 invitation policy and recipient binding are composed without granting Campaign authority.
PCV-02 memberSubjectIds has an explicit migration/adapter disposition and cannot remain a competing authority.
Duplicate/replayed invitation acceptance and conflicting reuse are fail-closed and idempotent.

tranches.name: Local-Host / Production-Service Authority & Entitlement Composition Closure
tranches.objective: Define one authority model shared by zero-service installed-host execution and the non-activated SMB-01 managed-production profile, including Identity/Entitlement/Persistence/SessionCommand/Realtime/Checkpoint ports.
acceptance: Define local-host adapters/semantics for the SMB-01 service-port surface without activating hosted production.
Define 'online' as current authoritative-executor reachability across local-host and future hosted profiles.
Define local entitlement evaluation and decision references used by Campaign/Session handshake.
Prove local-host authority and future server/database authority are deployment profiles over one owner model, not competing canonical histories.
Preserve realtime as advisory and durable Event/checkpoint authority across profiles.

tranches.name: Data Model, Persistence, Transaction, Secret & Migration Closure
tranches.objective: Close the durable-state model before runtime implementation: relational logical schema, product JSON aggregates, transactions, membership/session state, secret references, migration/retirement and provider-exit/data-rights implications.
acceptance: Declare one durable truth model and exact adapter mapping between canonical logical owners and the installed SQLite product store.
Provide or specify atomic transaction/batch primitives required by invitation/membership/Session operations.
Reconcile Campaign membership state/version schema and classify device/resume/ACK/epoch/replay data as canonical, local-secret or ephemeral.
Select/wire an approved Windows+Android secure-secret-store boundary and safe backup/export/delete behavior.
Define migration/retirement for pre-audit PCV-03.session.1 and any PCV-01/02 predecessor fields that change ownership.
No raw bearer/local identity credential material is allowed in ordinary documents, diagnostics or telemetry.

tranches.name: Transport, Protocol, Capability & Security Contract Closure
tranches.objective: Freeze the safe zero-service transport/handshake contract before code: inference-safe signaling, peer binding, versioned/bounded envelopes, policy/timeouts, exact capability/entitlement negotiation and replaceable assisted networking.
acceptance: Define pre-auth and post-auth signaling fields, recipient binding and no-log sensitive token handling.
Define peer-to-authenticated-subject/device binding and transport revalidation without granting authority to SDP/device metadata.
Define explicit protocol/schema versioning, strict decoder behavior, message/batch/work bounds, backpressure and safe errors.
Resolve exact pack/rules/runtime/entitlement handshake sources from locally measured client state.
Keep manual/no-service ICE as baseline and assisted STUN/TURN/relay as replaceable optional adapters.
Record governed invitation/connection timeout policy and future Android local-network permission trigger.

tranches.name: Session Event, Recovery, Idempotency, Presence & Hybrid Continuity Closure
tranches.objective: Freeze command/Event/checkpoint/reconnect semantics so local-host, future hosted, live/async/hybrid and hidden projections share one durable history without duplicate effects or lost Events.
acceptance: Define command identity versus idempotency key versus payload fingerprint and host-authoritative timestamps.
Define serialized per-Session mutation/transaction ordering and transactional-outbox/advisory-realtime mapping.
Define global authoritative Event sequence, viewer projection cursor, ACK timing, gap detection and hidden-event behavior.
Define checkpoint digest/trust/replay fingerprint lifecycle and reconnect current-authorization requirements.
Define presence as connection-derived advisory state with no membership/identity authority.
Prove compatibility with SMB-02 and APW one-history live/async/hybrid expectations.

tranches.name: Product Context, Downstream Consumers, Mobile, Packaging & Evidence Closure
tranches.objective: Close the product/platform edges before implementation: A3-safe Home/context integration, downstream Session consumers, mobile/accessibility, package/update identity and a non-self-certifying physical evidence model.
acceptance: Reconcile ProductProfile/ProductSelectedContext with A3 authorized workspace/context/Home projections and cache partitions.
Classify MAS/APW/VTI/SAA/WCI/MSAS/IC/A6/A7/A9/SMB13/BRP consumers without implementing downstream domains.
Define phone/keyboard/nonvisual requirements for every PCV networking control while leaving full Desktop View to PCV-09.
Define exact package/install/update/migration identity and device-side evidence needed for Windows/Android certification.
Replace boolean/self-reported completion evidence with causal receipts that prove duplicate retry, real resume, player delivery and installed binary identity.
Disposition unrelated PR #775 presentation/skin changes to their correct owner/scope.

tranches.name: Final No-Orphan / No-Parallel-Owner Readiness Certification
tranches.objective: Perform a fresh adversarial sweep over the completed interstitial artifacts and current repositories; allow PCV-03A to start only when all required owner/dependency/consumer/validation bindings are explicit and no unresolved implementation prerequisite remains.
acceptance: Every gap register item is closed, explicitly routed to a bounded PCV-03 child, or explicitly deferred outside PCV with owner/rationale; no unowned/indeterminate blocker remains.
Zero silent duplicate owners, authority bypasses, unresolved required dependencies, missing required consumers, persistence/secret/migration unknowns or evidence blind spots remain for PCV-03 scope.
Current canon/wiring matrix is updated with field-level PCV evidence rather than generic audit labels.
Per-child PCV-03A..03F validation profiles/negative-regression ownership are defined before implementation.
Application packaging remains disabled until PCV-03F.
A final fresh repository search for identity/membership/Session/transport/recovery/device/security/packaging consumers yields no uncatalogued required PCV dependency.
Only then may CURRENT select PCV-03A and grant implementation authority.

tranches.name: Canonical Identity, Invitation & Campaign Membership
tranches.outcome: Distinct Windows/Android users join through canonical local-first subject identity, recipient-bound A3 invitation semantics and A5 Campaign membership authority, with no parallel PCV-03 membership ledger.
acceptance: Bind production local profile/subject state to the canonical stable-subject session seam without making device identity or transport claims authoritative.
Implement recipient-bound, expiring, revocable, one-time/idempotent invitation acceptance through A3 semantics; raw invitation bearer material is not persisted in ordinary product documents.
Implement the local-first A5 Campaign membership adapter over durable product storage; Campaign role/state is the only membership/role authority used by PCV-03.
Support current membership states needed by PCV-03 authorization, including active/suspended/left/removed, and fail closed for unsupported role translations.
Bind accepted transport peers to the canonical subject/membership/device context so later commands/presence cannot impersonate another member.
PCV-03B+ and PCV-04 remain unauthorized until this item closes.

tranches.name: Session Launch, Lifecycle, Persistence & Authority Epoch
tranches.outcome: PCV-03 hosts one canonical A5 Session launched from an immutable validated Campaign/Scene snapshot, with durable lifecycle, close/supersession and authority-epoch behavior instead of a parallel Session shell.
acceptance: Consume the selected PCV-02 Campaign/Scene through A5 validation, immutable launch snapshot and exactly-once launch operation semantics.
Persist and project the canonical Session shell through the approved local-first storage adapter; PCV-03 transport state references it rather than replacing it.
Enforce launched/paused/closed lifecycle on join, command, projection and resume.
Closing or superseding a Session invalidates old invitation/resume surfaces and advances continuity/authority state as required.
Preserve canonical Campaign/Session ownership with no duplicate PCV-03 authority ledger.
PCV-03C+ and PCV-04 remain unauthorized until this item closes.

tranches.name: Secure Peer Transport, Protocol Validation & Capability Handshake
tranches.outcome: The direct/manual WebRTC path is a bounded, versioned, peer-bound zero-service transport with secure secret handling and a real client-measured capability handshake.
acceptance: Direct/manual WebRTC with no external ICE service is the first-class zero-service path; STUN/relay assistance remains optional and replaceable.
Every wire envelope has an explicit supported protocol/schema version and strict runtime validation; unknown/unsupported input fails safely.
Apply bounded message size, nesting, collection, batch and queued-work/backpressure limits.
Use approved secure storage for bearer/resume secret material; ordinary documents contain only safe references/digests.
Cryptographic secret generation fails closed when secure randomness is unavailable.
The joining client reports locally measured exact pack/rules/runtime/entitlement capability state rather than echoing host offer values.
Pre-auth signaling reveals only the minimum rendezvous material required for authorization.
PCV-03D+ and PCV-04 remain unauthorized until this item closes.

tranches.name: Ordered Delivery, Idempotency, Checkpoint & Reconnect Recovery
tranches.outcome: Commands, Events and reconnect use serialized host authority, semantic idempotency, durable cursors/checkpoints and current authorization without event loss or duplicate business effects.
acceptance: Serialize authoritative per-Session mutations so ordered transport cannot race durable reads/writes.
Narrow PCV-03 commands to PCV-03-owned schemas and reject conflicting reuse of an idempotency key via payload fingerprint.
Use host-authoritative receipt/Event timestamps rather than client clock claims.
Separate authoritative durable stream cursor from the visible player Event list and acknowledge only state actually delivered/processed.
Consume canonical ordered delivery to detect duplicates, gaps and cross-Session input and trigger authoritative recovery.
Advance content-hashed checkpoints/replay fingerprints over Session progress.
Reconnect revalidates current identity, membership, permission and Session status; post-membership transport resume does not require issuing another Campaign invitation.
PCV-03E+ and PCV-04 remain unauthorized until this item closes.

tranches.name: Presence, Product Context, Mobile UX & State Migration
tranches.outcome: Advisory presence and remote Campaign continuity integrate into the ordinary product safely on phone/desktop, and unsafe pre-audit PCV-03 persisted state is retired/migrated without inheriting stale authority or secrets.
acceptance: Presence is derived from the bound connection lifecycle and host time, never caller-supplied identity/authority.
Disconnect/reconnect updates advisory presence correctly while leaving membership authority separate.
Remote joined Campaign/Session continuity is represented as a role-safe local product context/cache without copying host authoritative Campaign truth into the player owner store.
Continuity keys support multiple Campaign/Session identities for one subject without collision.
Invitation/join/presence/reconnect controls pass phone-responsive, keyboard and nonvisual/accessibility checks.
Retire/quarantine pre-audit PCV-03.session.1 records and revoke old invitation/resume credentials; do not silently promote unsafe old records into the repaired authority model.
Strip or route unrelated presentation/skin changes out of the PCV-03 authority candidate.
PCV-03F and PCV-04 remain unauthorized until this item closes.

tranches.name: Exact-Head Installed Windows/Android Certification
tranches.outcome: A repaired exact-head Windows host and Android player pass automated predecessor regressions, package identity verification and causal physical-device evidence for join, authority, idempotency, hidden projection and reconnect.
acceptance: Run focused A3/A5/P9/SMB/VTI predecessor regressions plus PCV-03 negative/security/recovery tests and exact-head build/native checks.
Regenerate Windows and Android packages only from the repaired exact candidate head and bind the manifest to exact artifact hashes.

Installed evidence records causal receipts for distinct subject/device join, authoritative command, duplicate retry, disconnect, resume, ordered/gap-safe player delivery and hidden-before-publication filtering.
A second ordinary join cannot satisfy reconnect evidence and a single command cannot satisfy duplicate-idempotency evidence.
Device-side evidence binds installed Windows/Android runtime/package identity to the exact package artifact rather than relying only on self-reported wire metadata.
The physical Windows↔Android proof passes the strengthened verifier; only then may PCV-03 parent be considered completed_verified and PCV-04 become eligible.

tranches.name: Live Session, Rules, Actions & Combat Play Loop
tranches.outcome: Two people can actually play a core Multiversal encounter together from scene entry through action choice, GM adjudication, rules/dice resolution, combat, result/log, save, disconnect/reconnect and continuation.
acceptance: Live Scene, available actions, costs/requirements, proposal/approval/modify/reject, rule/calculation inspection and receipts operate over real shared session state.
Combat timing, targeting, reactions, hazards, conditions/resources and encounter conclusion operate cross-device without page-context loss.
GM/player secrecy and authority are proven on separate installed clients.
A completed encounter remains correct after restart/reconnect.

tranches.name: First-Party Adventure & Noncombat Play Convergence
tranches.outcome: The first-party campaign can be played beyond combat through exploration/travel/survival, investigation, social/relationships/reputation, downtime/cozy activity and ordinary scene transitions.
acceptance: SMB-09 first-party campaign content is reachable through real campaign/session UI.
Investigation, social and exploration runtimes consume shared session/state authority and persist outcomes.
Travel/survival, factions/organizations/settlements and relevant knowledge/reputation systems are integrated where current implementation supports them.
A cross-device session can move between noncombat and combat activities without losing authoritative context.

tranches.name: Inventory, Economy, Crafting, Games & Wagering, Vehicles, Mounts, Bases & Logistics
tranches.outcome: Long-lived shared assets and operational systems are usable in the real campaign: equipment, containers/transfers, economy/trade, crafting, reusable games/wagering activities, vehicles/living mounts, bases/facilities and logistics persist and synchronize between users.
acceptance: Real inventory/equipment/container ownership and transfers are persistent and permission-safe.
Economy/trade/contracts/services and crafting/work queues commit through governed events and survive reconnect.

Implement PCV_GAMES_WAGERING_INTEGRATION_v1.2.0.md as a reusable Games & Wagering runtime over current GPR loop-mini/pattern execution plus canonical owner-domain settlement; do not build a Black Vegas-only parallel engine.

Support Campaign Play using actual validated in-world character/campaign wealth, assets or other fictional stakes with persistent consequences, and Free Play using an isolated arbitrary resettable wallet that never mutates campaign state.

Ship a substantial Earth casino-game starter pack plus a Black Vegas/Multiversal starter pack, including external-event wager markets (especially races), MRC sanction/jurisdiction behavior where applicable, and culturally/economically distinct wagering such as subsistence-credit games, black-market egg/hatch pools and title-stake racing. Authoritative randomness/hidden information/external outcomes are recorded for replay/audit, and house/bookmaker/NPC/two-human participants use the current authority/continuity model.

Reject real-world-value stake sources and payouts: real money, paid entitlement/premium currency, cash-redeemable value, or anything convertible to those. Ordinary in-world currencies, items, favors and other owner-domain stakes remain allowed when their owning domain validates them.
Vehicle/mount/cargo/crew and base/facility/logistics views use current capability-driven models rather than hard-coded fantasy/space assumptions.
Cross-device contention/conflict behavior is explicit and recoverable.

MRC/regulator behavior is GM-selectable as off, light, custom-module or full. Turning it off removes taxes/licensing/sponsorship/enforcement/integrity overlays without removing the underlying games, races, betting markets, ownership settlement or replay/multiplayer behavior.

tranches.name: GM/Creator Authoring, Library, Rules & Content Sharing
tranches.outcome: A GM/creator can build and maintain actual campaign/world/adventure/content material inside the same product used for play, then share/publish it through existing governed boundaries.
acceptance: World/adventure/scene/content authoring, reusable Library, rules/search, dependencies, provenance/history and validation are integrated into the production shell.
MRCS and other current rules/content-authoring implementations are surfaced where they are user-facing rather than left as isolated workbenches.
Campaign-local creation remains distinct from reusable/canonical publishing authority.
Content can be transferred/shared between the two tester identities without bypassing rights/provenance controls.

Games & Wagering definitions are authorable as governed reusable content: game rules, table/venue configuration, legal fictional stake classes, house rules, dealer/NPC profiles and setting/alien game packs bind through MRCS/Content Forge boundaries without duplicating runtime or owner-domain authority.

tranches.name: Post-Bible Feature Convergence & Stranded-System Elimination
tranches.outcome: All later user-facing work added after the original Bibles is either integrated into coherent product navigation/workflows or explicitly classified as internal/deferred; no substantial implemented feature remains stranded behind a test/workbench.
acceptance: Converge applicable later families such as APM/async-cozy-AutoGM, APW hybrid activity, CSW creator tools, CEL, KFR, ISE, MAL, ODL, SCL, SSA, WCI, ECI and other live-source families discovered by the PCV ledger.
Preserve newer capabilities that supersede or extend older Bible assumptions.
Every production-like client surface has a product route/context or an explicit non-product classification with rationale.
No completion by deleting or hiding later features merely to match older documentation.

tranches.name: Full Product UX, Skin, Accessibility, Search, AI & Operations Convergence
tranches.outcome: The entire integrated product uses the current Multiversal interaction/visual system on phone and desktop, with coherent themes/skins, settings, search/command, notifications, AI proposal surfaces, diagnostics and accessibility instead of generic alpha panels.
acceptance: Consume the September UI Implementation Convergence Handoff and later UISK runtime/amendments as current presentation inputs; old Bibles remain floor/traceability only.
Global shell, Home, context navigation, inspectors, action docks, mobile transformations and current skin system are applied across real screens.
Search/command, notifications/approvals, settings/accessibility, diagnostics/recovery and optional AI proposal flows are reachable and permission-safe.
No ordinary-user surface exposes synthetic fixture labels, raw internal IDs or diagnostic-first copy unless explicitly in diagnostics.
Representative Android and Windows rendered evidence covers major play/authoring/utility surfaces and accessibility states.
Converge generated/imported/primary assets with current skins and eliminate accidental blank/generic presentation on representative product surfaces.

Games & Wagering has coherent responsive phone/desktop product surfaces: a generic games browser/table flow plus venue-aware presentation such as Black Vegas, accessible hidden-information handling, clear Campaign vs Free Play context, and no real-money purchase/cash-out affordance.

Phone exposes both responsive Phone View and an optional in-app Desktop View with zoom/pan over the full wide workspace; player, GM and creator capabilities remain functionally equivalent across phone and desktop.

tranches.name: Two-Human Golden Campaign, Recovery & Real Beta Installer
tranches.outcome: Fresh-installed Android and Windows builds support a real two-human Multiversal campaign between owner and second tester, with persistent cross-device play, recovery, meaningful feature breadth and regenerated beta installers from the exact validated head.
acceptance: Fresh install on Windows + Android; create/sign into distinct local tester identities; create or open campaign; invite/join; choose/create characters; enter session.
Play a representative first-party sequence containing noncombat interaction, inventory/resource use and a combat encounter, with GM/player role separation.
Disconnect/reconnect, app restart, save/load, update-compatible install and recovery preserve campaign/session history with no duplicate actions.
Exercise representative later/post-Bible systems appropriate to the campaign rather than proving only the old core.
Human-visible UI matches current convergence/skin direction on both devices and contains no alpha fixture shell.
Generate final Windows installer + Android APK with checksum/version manifest only after this installed two-human proof passes.
No unresolved required asset remains on the representative first-party two-human golden path.

Installed proof exercises Games & Wagering on Windows and Android: at least one Earth game and one Black Vegas/alien game, a persistent campaign-funded wager, an isolated Free Play wallet reset, and a two-human or host-authoritative table/reconnect path, with zero real-world-value wagering.
Installed Android proof demonstrates representative player and GM/creator workflows in Phone View and the same capability set through Desktop View zoom/pan without state, permission or action loss.

completion_rule: PCV completes only when PCV-10 proves a fresh-installed Android and Windows pair can run a real two-human Multiversal campaign using persisted governed state and representative current feature breadth. Contract-only, fixture-only, golden-data-only, isolated-workbench-only, screenshot-only, or in-process-only proof is insufficient.
next_action: PCV-I03 is selected_not_started. Start only on a later owner Continue; all Multiversal-app PCV runtime remains blocked through PCV-I06.

approved_cross_tranche_requirements.name: Games & Wagering Integration
approved_cross_tranche_requirements.current_rule: PCV-03 may preserve shared authority/continuity compatibility only; Games & Wagering implementation remains blocked until PCV-06 predecessor closeout.
approved_cross_tranche_requirements.scope_note: Applies across intrinsic games and wager markets over external Multiversal events; MRC and other jurisdiction overlays are GM-selectable off/light/custom/full and never required to use the underlying game/race/market.

approved_cross_tranche_requirements.name: Full-Capability Mobile + Desktop View
approved_cross_tranche_requirements.current_rule: Every user-facing capability implemented by the active PCV tranche must remain usable from phone. Phone-native responsive presentation is required immediately; the shared in-app Desktop View zoom/pan mode is fully converged in PCV-09 and terminally proven in PCV-10.
approved_cross_tranche_requirements.scope_note: Applies equally to player, GM and creator capabilities. Larger desktop screens may show more simultaneous panes, but capability availability, authority, persistence and actions must not differ by form factor.

PCV-03.completion_rule: PCV-03 parent is completed_verified only when PCV-03A through PCV-03F are completed_verified in strict order.
